Introduction

Hyojung is a South Korean singer under WM Entertainment. She is the leader and lead vocalist of the girl group OH MY GIRL, as well as a member of its sub-unit OH MY GIRL BANHANA.

She joined WM Entertainment and trained for only six months before debuting, which is considered a relatively short training period in the kpop industry. Hyojung made her official debut on April 20, 2015, with OH MY GIRL's self-titled debut mini album "Oh My Girl."

On April 2, 2018, she joined the group's sub-unit OH MY GIRL BANHANA for the release of the special album "Banana Allergy Monkey." Known for her leadership and vocal strength, Hyojung continues to contribute to the group’s musical direction and public presence.
